articles.body:
If "Treasury Reform" has passed, do regiments or local alliances still get paid? (I understand commanders and officers don't get paid)

By RAW, it says all loot, so I am assuming they don't get a cut

Example:
Deploy action with one officer, one regiment, and one local alliance. Only one tower level, no bonus: £4 total.

Does the Company balance receive £4 or £2?

articles.body:
[q="GrayPockets"]If "Treasury Reform" has passed, do regents or local alliances still get paid? (I understand commanders and officers don't get paid)

By RAW, it says all loot, so I am assuming they don't get a cut

Example:
Deploy action with one officer, one regiment, and one local alliance. Only one tower level, no bonus: £4 total.

Does the Company balance receive £4 or £2?[/q]

My assumption was, like yours, all loot as the card says. 

I think that makes sense thematically too - the word “loot” makes it clear that this is not wages that are being paid, but plunder being claimed without the company ever hearing about it. 

If the commander and officers aren’t getting a cut, they’re not going to turn a blind eye to the rank and file, and the mercenaries, stealing the Company’s booty.

articles.body:
The way the playtesting groups I was in played it, it applies to the loot that was otherwise actually paid to players. You’re right though that RAW suggest something stronger.

Thematically, it seems to me that the alliances at least would need to be paid.
